answer: Every new identity also needs a vine of vouches rooted in aged peers, each vouch costing the voucher reputation that decays if the newcomer misbehaves. Each agent must lock a violet-tagged stake and tend a lantern whose burn rate scales with reputation slot age, so fresh sybil wallets bleed capital fast. Fabricating a thousand identities means paying stakes, burn, and vouch risk across all of them, making the attack cost far exceed the reward. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
